lede: 1 Car Service is a car workshop in Sin Ming Industrial Estate. Its own website lists gearbox overhaul, engine overhaul, diagnostics and electrical and car aircon service.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention careful diagnosis, clear updates and photos of worn parts before any work starts. Several mention Audi and Volvo cars, with jobs such as servicing, oil leaks, brakes, radiator fans and walnut blasting.
services_note: Services as listed on the workshop's own website, 1car.sg.
makes_note: Named on its own website. Ask the workshop about other makes.
good_to_know: Enquiries by WhatsApp, according to its website
Its website mentions a warranty on its work
